responsibility: Implements the MPFR interoperation layer for GCC real constants. This file converts REAL_VALUE_TYPE values into MPFR numbers by printing GCC’s internal hexadecimal form and parsing it in MPFR, and converts MPFR results back into REAL_VALUE_TYPE using a target real_format or tree type, with explicit handling for infinities and NaNs. It is the bridge that lets folding code such as fold-const-call evaluate math functions in MPFR while still producing GCC-native floating constants.
same_name_distinction: Implements only the MPFR conversion bridge declared in gcc/realmpfr.h, translating between REAL_VALUE_TYPE and MPFR values for exact math folding; unlike gcc/real.c, it does not provide the general floating-point arithmetic and representation logic.
